scope: five short S14 pilot clips, not full films

pilots.name: 织光
pilots.look: An exquisitely tactile embroidered textile film world. Everything is sculpted from silk thread, wool felt and hand-stitched fabric with clearly visible tiny stitches. Rain appears as fine silver filaments; warm lamp light catches golden embroidery. Adult proportions and readable sculpted faces, sophisticated macro material detail, restrained color, cinematic depth of field. Physical fabric forms, not a drawing printed on cloth.
pilots.move: Subtle stitched cloth flexes and silver rain threads move in the background. Keep textile fibers consistent.

Single cinematic opening frame for a continuous shot from THE LAST LIGHT OF RAIN CITY. Adult East Asian woman Xiaohe, age 20, chin-length straight black bob with blunt bangs, mustard-yellow rain jacket with hood down, navy trousers, small red canvas shoulder satchel, black ankle boots. She kneels at screen left under a dry stone overhang, compassionately facing Yuandian at screen right: knee-high spherical cream robot, exactly two teal round eyes, one small simple mouth, two short feet and two flipper arms. Robot's own right flipper (on the viewer's left) droops; no blood, no exposed cables. Her two hands hold the two ends of one narrow cream cloth support band that is already loosely around this flipper, ready to tighten a simple knot. Keep her face, both hands, bandage and robot face clearly visible in the middle of frame, avoid overlaps. One brass curved-handle glass lantern stands safely on the ground beside them, with a weak but visible warm amber flame. Robot chest hatch remains closed, no exposed crystal. Cool rain falls beyond the overhang, wet mountain stone steps recede toward a distant lighthouse. Eye-level medium two-shot, 50mm-like perspective, 16:9, one consistent spatial arrangement. No titles, letters, signs, logos, watermark, collage or panels. Only these two characters, no duplicates or extra limbs.
pilots.video_prompt: Continue exactly from the reference frame in 丝线刺绣 style. A single unbroken 10-second eye-level medium two-shot; no cuts and no added characters. Xiaohe slowly draws the two ends of the existing cream cloth band snug around the robot's already drooping own RIGHT flipper, then gently secures one small support knot and rests one hand beside the arm. This is one careful comforting action, never pulling or removing the arm. The robot glances up toward her with two teal eyes; she gives one small reassuring smile. The brass lantern stays standing in its original ground position and its weak amber flame remains lit throughout. Chest hatch stays closed. Preserve exactly the original character shapes, face count, clothing, attached limbs, material style and spatial layout. Subtle stitched cloth flexes and silver rain threads move in the background. Keep textile fibers consistent. A very slow nearly imperceptible push-in; no orbit. No speech or lip-sync, no new text, logos, duplicate fingers, extra hands, camera cuts, magical transformation or sudden lighting changes. Use first six seconds for the slow tightening, final four seconds for the small reassuring glance and quiet breathing.

pilots.name: 影中灯
pilots.look: An elegant translucent leather shadow-puppet cinema seen through a softly backlit silk screen. Delicately perforated dyed leather figures, restrained amber, indigo and jade color, multi-layer silhouette stone architecture and deep parallax. Fine articulated puppet hands and flippers are physically connected. The girl's human face is a readable carved profile, robot spherical silhouette and two teal eyes unmistakable. Stagecraft with subtle surface texture, no visible rods.
pilots.move: Graceful precisely articulated shadow-puppet motion, tiny parallax of layered scenery; keep silhouettes crisp and connected.

pilots.name: 普鲁士蓝的黎明
pilots.look: A high-art moving cyanotype photographic print: deep Prussian-blue architecture, pale silver photographic figures, luminous white rain marks, authentic fine cotton paper grain and subtle darkroom bloom. Delicately hand-tinted restrained mustard jacket, red satchel, teal robot eyes and amber lantern are the only chromatic accents. Coherent photographed sculptural characters and realistic readable hand anatomy, not sketch lines. Sophisticated composition with fine emulsion texture.
pilots.move: Subtle photographic parallax and organic silver rain; grain stays fine and steady without boiling, tearing or morphing.

Tangible brass lantern, damp basalt masonry, fine real rain and soft cool dusk. Warm practical lamp illumination on faces. Restrained 35mm film texture and natural optics; absolutely not cartoon or glossy CGI.

Layered indigo-stained wood architecture, visible fine directional wood grain and tiny brass pivots. The bandage is real soft ivory fabric distinct from the wood. Gentle sculptural fairy-tale lighting, museum-quality craftsmanship, no clay or paper.
